title: Pricing plans
text: Acme Voice has three plans billed in Indian rupees: Starter at ₹4,999 per month for one website and 1,000 conversations, Growth at ₹14,999 per month for three websites and 5,000 conversations, and Scale with custom pricing for unlimited websites. Annual billing saves two months.

title: Free trial
text: Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. No credit card is needed to start the trial, and you can switch plans or cancel at any time from the billing page.

title: Conversation overage
text: If you go over your plan's monthly conversations, extra conversations are charged at ₹4 each. You get an email alert at 80% and 100% of your allowance, and you can set a hard cap so the agent never goes over.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, and net banking through Razorpay. Invoices include GST and are emailed to the account owner every month.

title: CRM integrations
text: Leads captured by the agent can be sent to HubSpot, Salesforce and Zoho CRM. Each lead carries the visitor's name, email, company, the questions they asked and a lead score.

title: Slack and webhooks
text: Hot-lead alerts can be posted to a Slack channel. Any other system can receive leads and conversation events through a signed webhook with retries.

title: Installing on WordPress
text: To install on WordPress, add the plugin from the plugin directory, paste your widget key in the settings page and save. The widget appears on every page; you can exclude pages by URL.

title: Installing with a script tag
text: On any other website, paste one script tag before the closing body tag. The tag carries your widget key; the agent then reads your site's pages and is ready in a few minutes.

title: Where data is stored
text: All customer data is stored in data centres in Mumbai, India. Backups are encrypted and kept in a second Indian region for disaster recovery.

title: Encryption
text: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256. API keys you give us, such as your CRM tokens, are encrypted with a separate key.

title: Compliance
text: Acme Voice follows the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Our SOC 2 Type II audit is in progress, and a data processing agreement is available on request.

title: Masking personal details
text: Emails, phone numbers and card numbers that visitors type are masked before anything is stored or sent to the AI model. The agent only sees placeholders.

title: How long conversations are kept
text: Conversation transcripts are kept for 90 days by default. You can choose 30, 180 or 365 days, and a visitor can ask for their data to be deleted at any time.

title: Voice and the microphone
text: Visitors can talk to the agent by voice in the browser. The microphone is used only while voice is on, the visitor is asked first, and audio is never recorded or stored.

title: Languages
text: The agent answers in English and Hindi. A visitor who asks in Hindi gets the answer in Hindi, by voice too, while product names and prices stay as written.

title: How long setup takes
text: Most teams are live in under an hour: install the widget, let the agent read the site, review its first answers and switch it on. No engineering work is needed.

title: What the agent learns from
text: The agent learns from your website pages, PDFs and help-centre articles that you add. It answers only from this content and says so when it doesn't know.

title: Accuracy and sources
text: Every answer is grounded in your own content and shows the sources it used. If no source covers a question, the agent offers to connect the visitor with your team instead of guessing.

title: Talking to a person
text: Your team can watch live conversations and take over at any moment, by text or a voice call in the browser. The agent pauses while a person is in charge and resumes afterwards.

title: Lead scoring
text: Each visitor gets a lead score from 0 to 100 based on what they asked, the pages they viewed and buying signals such as asking for a demo or pricing for many seats.

title: Analytics and insights
text: The insights dashboard shows the questions visitors ask most, the questions the agent couldn't answer, objections such as price or security, and competitors mentioned.

title: Weekly email digest
text: Every Monday morning, owners and admins get an email summary of the past week: conversations, leads, top questions and gaps in your content.

title: A/B testing
text: You can test two to four greetings, triggers or designs against each other. Visitors are split automatically and the dashboard tells you when one version is clearly better.

title: Proactive triggers
text: Triggers open the agent or show a short message when a visitor scrolls far, stays on the pricing page, or is about to leave, so they can ask before they go.

title: Design levels
text: Choose how the agent looks: a classic chat panel, an immersive full-screen presence, or an ambient search bar. All three match your brand colours and fonts.

title: Team members and roles
text: Invite your team as owners, admins, editors or viewers. Editors can change answers and settings; viewers can only read conversations and reports.

title: Single sign-on
text: Teams can sign in with Google or any OpenID Connect provider such as Okta or Azure AD. Admins can require single sign-on for everyone in their domain.

title: Conversation recaps
text: A visitor can ask the agent to send them the conversation. They get a private link to a recap page with the answers and charts, which they can forward to their team.

title: Support
text: Support is available by email on all plans and by phone on Growth and Scale, from 9 am to 7 pm IST on working days. Scale customers get a named account manager.

title: Cancelling
text: You can cancel from the billing page at any time. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid month, and you can export your leads and conversations before you go.
